references.text: The same chapter describes how the children of Israel broke camp and set out according to the Lord's command, providing the immediate context for this verse.
Describes the first departure after the Lord's command through Moses, illustrating the practical fulfillment of the principle in 9:23.
A foundational text about the cloud over the tabernacle that led Israel's journeys, serving as the background for the instructions in Numbers.
The children of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded Moses, showing their obedience to the Lord's commands.
Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord had commanded him, confirming Moses' role as the mediator of God's word.
A prayer that God's Spirit may lead on firm ground, reflecting the desire for divine guidance.
An encouragement to trust in the Lord and not in one's own understanding, and He will make your paths straight - parallel to following the Lord's guidance.
Jesus' sheep hear his voice and follow him, reflecting the theme of following divine guidance.
